description: window.selectTextIn(selector, text) selects the first occurrence of text inside the first element matching selector, as a user's selection would; call it in an eval. "The comment button" is the element with data-testid "message-selection-comment-btn". To check the message input's value exactly, eval JSON.stringify(document.querySelector('[data-testid="message-input"]').value) and compare it with the JSON string given. Selecting text in the user's own message does not offer Comment. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/reply. 2. The first message that is not commentable ('[data-testid="message"]:not([data-commentable="true"])') should contain "echo: reply text here". 3. Eval window.selectTextIn('[data-testid="message"]:not([data-commentable="true"])', 'reply text here'). 4. Give the page's selectionchange handling a turn: eval new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r))). 5. The comment button must then be hidden (or absent).
